title: Why every gamer knows up, up, down, down
caption: The Konami Code was made because the developer couldn't beat his own game. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #konamicode #konami

instagram.caption:
The Konami Code exists because a developer struggled with his own game.

Kazuhisa Hashimoto was porting Gradius to the NES and found it too hard to play through, so he added a secret input that gave full power-ups. It shipped by accident.

Players discovered it, Contra made it famous with 30 lives, and it is still hidden in games and websites today.

Do you still know it by heart?
